notes:
Did: .github/verify-phase3-preparation-privacy.cjs (checker) and .test.cjs (13 tests), run by the gate's node --test .github/*.test.cjs. scanRepository checks: (1) Rust in src-tauri/src/{documents,preparation,planning}: every info!/warn!/error! (log::, tracing:: or bare) may interpolate only error, removed or run.id (format placeholders, tracing fields and positional args); no println!/eprintln!/print!/eprint!/dbg!; no mention of analytics. (2) Frontend components/preparation/*.tsx, lib/{document,planning,preparation}-service.ts, app/preparation/page.tsx: no mention of analytics (case-insensitive, so lib/analytics, AnalyticsContext and invoke('track_analytics_…') are all caught); no import of @tauri-apps/plugin-fs or plugin-dialog; console.log/info/warn/error may pass only string literals, error, loadError or result.code. (3) Import: documents_import takes only app and state, document-service calls it with no args, import.rs picks through app.dialog().file(), ReplaceSource is exactly Paste { text } | Import, and ReplaceSource::Import calls pick(app). (4) Route: briefing-block re-validates with validateProviderRoute, checks isRouteAvailable on that value and passes it to generateBriefing; it shows RunNotice and disables Prepare unless routeState is validated and not blocked; prep_generate is invoked with expectedRoute; preparation::commands::begin calls validate_route_contract before its first .await. Scratch edits (not committed): an Analytics.track('source_added', { title }) added to sources-panel.tsx and a log::info!("imported {title}") added to documents/import.rs each made the repo-scan test fail. Both files were then restored.
Learned: the existing code already met every rule, so nothing outside .github changed. The log allowlist trusts `error`: documents::commands::error_code logs {error:#} for non-code anyhow errors, and that is safe only while no .with_context adds a path or title. A new info+ log in these modules that interpolates anything other than error/removed/run.id fails the gate, so log identifiers at debug or add them to RUST_LOG_ALLOWED with a reason. A .ts file added under components/preparation is not scanned (only .tsx). Route confirmation is checked by text presence in briefing-block.tsx, not by tying the disabled prop to the button that calls generateBriefing.
